financing.summary: Stone Martin is a conventional for-sale homebuilder that funds itself privately: owner equity through a holding company (Sky Holdings, Inc.) and secured bank credit, with nothing rated, registered or disclosed. State lien records show its land affiliate, SMB Land, LLC, borrowing from Texas Capital Bank (since 2020, renewed in 2025) and from smaller regional lenders (Southern States Bank, BankPlus, Listerhill Credit Union), which points to a traditional buy-develop-and-own land model financed loan by loan. No land banker, lot-option partner, outside equity investor or joint-venture land partner is named in any public source opened, and no link to Domain, Millrose, Kennedy Lewis or TPG Angelo Gordon was found. For a land banker that means an open field but a small one: roughly 650 to 800 closings a year across secondary Alabama markets, with a CEO who personally came up through land.
financing.land_strategy: Appears to own and develop most of its land (inferred, not stated by the company). The company describes itself as building homes and developing its own communities, invites landowners to sell to it through a land-submissions page, and holds land in an affiliate (SMB Land, LLC) with bank liens. It has stated no land-light target and published no owned versus optioned split.

lots.source_title: Stone Martin Builders land submissions page
lots.note: Lot counts are not publicly disclosed (private company). The only public scale marker is the company's Feb 2025 statement that it had more than 45 communities and planned 800+ homes in 2025.

land_banking.description: Affiliated land-holding entity (formed May 2015, organizer Mitchell R. Martin, registered agent Frank Plan, same Opelika address as the builder). It is the borrower on the bank lien filings, so it appears to be where land is acquired, developed and financed before homes are built. This is an in-house structure, not a third-party land bank.
land_banking.source_title: Alabama Secretary of State business entity record: SMB Land, LLC (000-334-259)
land_banking.note: The entity's existence, officers and lenders are from state records; its role in the land process is inferred from those records, not stated by the company.

debt.instrument: Secured credit to land affiliate SMB Land, LLC (Texas Capital Bank)
debt.lenders_agent: Texas Capital Bank, National Association (Richardson, TX)
debt.source_title: Alabama Secretary of State UCC filing 20-7672062
debt.note: Financing statement filed 2020-09-15 against SMB Land, LLC; continued 2025-03-16, so the relationship was renewed rather than allowed to lapse; filing now runs to 2030-09-15. Texas Capital is a Texas commercial bank that lends to homebuilders, so this may be a land or lot facility, but the type and size are not public. A UCC financing statement shows a secured lending relationship and that the lien filing is still active; it does not show the loan amount, whether it is drawn, or the collateral (mortgages on the land itself are recorded at county level).

key_metrics.source_title: Alabama Secretary of State business entity record: Stone Martin Builders, LLC

gaps: Owned versus optioned lots, total lots controlled and years of supply: not publicly disclosed (private company).

Loan amounts, rates, maturities and covenants for the Texas Capital Bank, Southern States Bank, BankPlus, Listerhill Credit Union and Alabama Ag Credit relationships: not publicly disclosed; only the lien filings are public. County mortgage records (Lee, Montgomery, Madison, Limestone, Houston counties) would show loan amounts by parcel but were not searched.
Home-construction (vertical) lender to Stone Martin Builders, LLC itself: not identified. The only state lien against the builder entity is an old John Deere equipment filing.

Land banker, lot-option provider or outside equity partner: none named publicly. No public link to Domain Real Estate Partners, Millrose Properties, Kennedy Lewis or TPG Angelo Gordon was found in any page opened; the dedicated search for those names could not be run because the shared web-search allowance ran out.
M&A 2025-2026: none found, as acquirer or target. No sale, recapitalisation or acquisition of Stone Martin Builders has been reported.
Total debt, cash, liquidity and leverage: not publicly disclosed. No credit ratings and no SEC filings exist.

Unconfirmed lead, not entered as a fact: a property-data aggregator (sfranalytics.com) associates Stone Martin Builders LLC with one recorded-mortgage lender, Windstone Private Lending LLC. This could not be confirmed in any primary record.
Whether SMB Properties Inc. (a separate Alabama lien debtor with ServisFirst and SouthPoint Bank filings) is related to Stone Martin: not established; left out.
Builder's Oct 2022 Q&A with CEO Frank Plan, which may describe land strategy in his own words, could not be opened (site blocks automated reading).
